purpose: Research follow-up after v5 error analysis; all historical cycles previously inspected; not a new blind test
outer: 14 leave-one-whole-cycle-out folds and the same three forward blocks as v5
inner: three deterministic complete-cycle groups; fit preprocessing and censoring distribution on training only
selection: inner cycle-macro MAE + 0.5 * last2h MAE; baselines eligible
sampling: one origin per processing minute with equal total cycle weight; RSF additionally every fifth sampled origin and duration rounded upward to 0.1h for bounded memory
ipcw: training marginal censoring KM, G floor 0.1; assumption-dependent
cqrnn: Portnoy hard-EM weights with nearest predicted quantile; 19 monotone quantiles, 12 tanh units, 350 epochs, AdamW 0.015/0.03, two seeds 17/43; raw-hour check loss divided by 10; ystar=max(80,2*max training observed/censored duration)
mixture: two lognormal components, 8 tanh units, shared learned scales, exact censored mixture likelihood; two seeds; 300 epochs AdamW 0.012/0.04; inspired by DSM, not a reproduction
ipcw_hgb: five quantiles, max_leaf_nodes=7,max_iter=120,min_samples_leaf=100,l2=10,lr=.05, no row-random early stopping
rsf: 80 trees,max_depth=5,min_samples_leaf=25,max_features=.7,seed=20261120; right tail quantiles beyond identifiable support reported at support+24h with separate unresolved fraction
warning: Separate wall-clock y_eol_60m head: logistic6 and HGB32, inner OOF threshold selection; never interpret processing-hour CDF as wall-clock probability
limits: Historical offline product eligibility is not validated for live deployment
